evidence.title: Dark Beacon Lamp
evidence.description: The great lamp is cold. The keeper's slate notes the light failed at twenty to midnight.

evidence.title: Emptied Oil Store
evidence.description: The oil store is bone dry. A full night's oil does not simply vanish.

evidence.title: Undamaged Store Lock
evidence.description: A close look at the store lock: no scratches, no force. It was opened with a key.

evidence.title: Spare Key in Finn's Coat
evidence.description: In the pocket of Finn's coat: a spare brass store key, smelling faintly of lamp oil.

evidence.title: Harbor Debt Ledger
evidence.description: The open ledger: Finn owes the harbormaster more than a year's wages, due at moon's end.

evidence.title: Oily Footprint
evidence.description: A fresh lamp-oil footprint on the lamp-room stair, heading down.

evidence.title: Finn's Sea Boots
evidence.description: Slick with the same lamp oil as the stair print; the tread matches exactly.

evidence.title: Floured Apron
evidence.description: Odda's apron, caked in flour from collar to hem, still damp with kneading sweat.

evidence.title: Corwin's Testimony
evidence.description: Corwin admits he saw Finn on the lamp-room stair at the time the light failed.
evidence.note: Testimony, not objective truth: the source is recorded and it only feeds rules alongside other facts.

evidence.title: Finn's Alibi Claim
evidence.description: Finn insists he was in the bunkroom all night and never climbed the stair.
evidence.note: A claim, not a fact about the world: only usable via the alibi-contradiction rule.

evidence.title: Odda's Alibi Claim
evidence.description: Odda states she never left the galley after supper; the bread proves it.
evidence.note: A claim, not a fact about the world: only usable via the alibi-contradiction rule.
